title: Specify secure OCR L1 contract, private upload and untrusted perception
whatBuilt: AUTHORIZED PRIVATE UPLOAD: owner-scoped upload intent -> PRIVATE quarantine with SHA-256 digest; format bounds via magic-byte check (png/jpeg); size bounds; malformed/oversized/empty uploads refused
PRIVATE STORAGE DENY PATHS: cross-owner upload/job/result access denied; digests bind bytes so tampering is detectable
PARSER JOB: bounded job over quarantined bytes -> STRUCTURAL result (pages -> regions -> text hypotheses with confidence + engine version); structural bounds (pages/regions/text length) enforced

UNTRUSTED PERCEPTION: every OCR text is a HYPOTHESIS — marked untrustedPerception, scanned for injected script/URL payloads (refused), sourceAuthorized: False and masteryGranted: False unconditionally — parsing is NOT source authorization
CANCELLATION: parser-job cancellation is a defined outcome (cancelled jobs refuse completion)

QUALIFICATION GATE RECORDED: benchmarkQualified False until VOCR-02 measures real engines; provenance routing to Learn/Ask/Practice/Build (VOCR-03 seam) carries provenance + hypotheses, NEVER hidden answer keys

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 155/155 pass (146 previous + 9 OCR)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: The engine is a SEAM (synthetic in tests); real OCR engines, Indian-script/handwriting benchmark qualification (VOCR-02) and hosted safety/rollout acceptance (VOCR-04) remain gated.
